checked_sources: independent fresh forcing simulation for four profiles
correctness.rationale: A two-white pair in any peripheral clique is a permanent false-twin-like obstruction to ordinary blue-only forcing; every clique therefore starts with at most one white vertex. If hub is blue, cliques complete; if hub is white, a completely blue peripheral clique forces the hub, while one omitted vertex in each clique is an initial deadlock. Counting gives z^s[(1+z)∏(z+r_i)-∏r_i], and the valuation s+1 gives z(G;Z)=C(1+Σ1/r_i). Setting H=z^(−s)Z yields Q=(H(z)−H(−1))/(z+1), so roots recover the full multiset, including repetitions and t=1. The independent white-vertex Bernoulli model yields P=∏a_i−(1−p)∏b_i with independent deficiency indicators. Under L=Σbinom(r_i,2)→∞ and R=max r_i=o(√L), Σ(1−a_i)→λ², max_i(1−a_i)→0 and cubic remainders O(RL(λ/√L)^3)→0, giving Poisson(λ²), forcing success e^(−λ²), unique median and √L(1−p_half)→√log2. Independent fresh all-subset forcing simulations matched polynomial for (2), (2,3), (3,3), (2,2,3), including 256 subsets in latter; analytic argument covers arbitrary profiles.
